authority: PreQA2 is the official validation environment for the SMB scenarios assigned to this scope. A TC may be marked PASS when its official Expected Result is fully proven here with runtime evidence.
policy: Do not mark PASS from page availability or superficial navigation.
PASS requires the official Expected Result to be exercised and observed in PreQA2.
Guest versus registered execution must follow the official TC.
WMC authentication does not imply Samsung Account authentication.
Do not invent Expected Results, selectors, SKUs, promotions or test data.
Never retain cookies, tokens, credentials, sensitive query strings or authentication URLs in this ledger.
Payment/order submission, cron jobs and profile writes remain behind their existing explicit destructive guards.
